# Parking Vault High-Volume System

## Overview
High-concurrency automated parking reservation system managing municipal parking reservations.
Source Reference: [Distributed Locking Architecture](https://example.com/parking-locking)

## Core Architectural Patterns
- Redis Redlock distributed hold pattern with 10-minute slot expiration TTL.
- Pessimistic row-level locking via SELECT FOR UPDATE prevents duplicate spot assignments.
- Read-heavy availability queries offloaded to Redis replica cluster with 5-second TTL.

## Concurrency and Race Mitigation
Enforces deterministic locking order by slot_id ASC to prevent deadlocks under high concurrent reservation volume.
Scale Hint: 50,000 concurrent reservation requests per minute across 100,000 slots.

## Scale Considerations and Lessons
Queue-based rate limiting buffers ingress traffic spikes during peak morning arrival windows.
